# SoulX-Singer (vendored)

The `soulxsinger/` folder is an unmodified copy of the inference code from
https://github.com/Soul-AILab/SoulX-Singer (copied 2026-10-18), by Soul AI Lab.
Licence: Apache-2.0, see `LICENSE` in this folder.

The model weights (`model.pt`) are published at https://huggingface.co/Soul-AILab/SoulX-Singer
(Apache-2.0 per that page) and are shipped in the full installer, not in this repository.

AI Purrformer itself is AGPL-3.0. Apache-2.0 code can be combined with AGPL-3.0 code.
Respect SoulX-Singer's own usage notes: no impersonation, no deceptive audio.
